properties.name: vadmin.local-iam.enabled
properties.description: Enables the built-in local IAM, including username/password login and the Users, Roles, Permissions, and Audit administration module. Set to false only when the host application provides its own identity and authorization beans.

properties.name: vadmin.local-iam.table-prefix
properties.description: Prefix for the six local IAM tables. The default vadmin becomes the physical prefix vadmin_. A blank value is rejected and does not fall back to unprefixed names. Flyway V2 renames the original tables once; the prefix is then frozen, while constraint and index names stay unchanged.
